summary: Build AI-enabled shared services, establish automation CoEs, and redesign back-office operating models. Join TrainingCred's 5-day practical course.
lede: Shared services courses cover assessing service maturity and designing back-office operating models that combine people, workflows and automation. For functional managers and transformation leads, the practical focus is reshaping cross-functional services: mapping workflows, scoring automation opportunities, and setting governance and service-level measures to manage exceptions and track performance.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals responsible for leading, managing, or optimizing shared service operations, multi-functional CoEs, and back-office process transformation initiatives.
modules: Shared Services Architecture and GBS Maturity
Digital Service Catalog and Service Level Frameworks
Intelligent Automation Intake and Feasibility Scoring
Performance Measurement and Business Value Realization
GBS Transformation Strategy and Executive Roadmap
prerequisites: Working knowledge of back-office operations, service delivery management, or process improvement concepts. No programming or software engineering background required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
